question: Estimate EV adoption rate (% of new vehicle sales) in India by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Across all segments: 2W + 3W + cars + buses + trucks? Yes — segmented.
Adoption = % of new vehicle sales (not stock)? Yes.
Realistic vs aspirational policy target? Realistic.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Segment-by-segment forecasting using current trajectory + policy/infra constraints.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: 2W (currently ~7% EV in 2026): trajectory to ~25-30% by 2030 (driven by FAME, state subsidies, fleet electrification, total cost of ownership advantage).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Passenger cars (currently ~3% EV in 2026): ~15-18% by 2030 (Tata, Mahindra, MG, Maruti pushing aggressively; charging infra still constraint).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Trucks: <5% by 2030 (heavy-duty EV tech and infra not ready).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Weighted average across new vehicle sales (2W is ~75% of unit volume): ~2W weight: 25-30% × 0.75 + cars 16% × 0.10 + 3W 60% × 0.05 + buses 18% × 0.005 + trucks 4% × 0.10 ≈ 22-25%.
